notes.title: 2024 Review and Outlook 2025
notes.content:
This has been quite a year! Thank you everyone for playing my games! ❤️

I've released 25 levels with 2,500 hidden cats. Hundreds of thousands of you have played my games this year, a number which is simply unfathomable to me. I live a tranquil life in the countryside with limited social interactions outside of my family and I'm rarely active on social media. It's such a stark contrast. ^^

Additionally, there has been a new free level for Cats Hidden in Jingle Jam, a free game made together with Devcats, a complete remake of Cats Hidden in Georgia and countless other minor QoL updates across all games. Cats Hidden in Italy and Cats Hidden in Bali have also been released on Nintendo Switch! And another port is already in the works for quite some months. 

Here's a little overview of the games I released this year and further down some information abuot what's to come in 2025 and beyond.

[h1]February[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485180/

[h1]April[/h1]

[h1]June[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2377970/

[h1]October[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2776570/

[h1]December[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2933990/



[h1]Coming 2025[/h1]

There will be less games in 2025. Right now, I have only two confirmed. 
The rest of the time, I want to spend updating the games that are already out. Like porting them to the improved framework with the multi-step zoom that is used by all the recent games to bring them all to the same level feature-wise.

Last but not least, I started working on a completely new game that is not a Hidden Object game but still situated in the Travellin Cats Universe. I hope to be able to release it in late 2025 but we'll see how it goes. 

Please wishlist the upcoming games if you haven't already. :)

notes.title: New Free Level Now Available!
notes.content:
To celebrate the start of Jingle Jam 2024 I've got a major update for you.

Nina was kind enough to draw us another free level. And she has outdone herself. This year, the cats got lost on a ski trip in a winter wonderland, and I need your help to find them all. The whole game has also been transferred to a new framework, adding many features and QoL improvements. 

[h1]Update Overview[/h1][list]
[*] [b]New level[/b] with 100 hidden cats
[*] Multi-step zoom
[*] Adjustable background and cat color
[*] Increased visual fidelity for resolutions of 1080p and lower
[/list]This has been a huge undertaking, so bugs might happen. If you find any, please report them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2608050/discussions/0/4033599096402480476/?ctp=3]here.[/url] 

While you're already here,[b] please vote to nominate the game for a Steam Award[/b]. It would be insane if we could get nominated and, through that, spread even more awareness for the Jingle Jam charity event. 

Peace & Love 
Patrick


[h3]If you're thirsting for even [b]more free Christmas content[/b], Cats Hidden in Christmas is about to drop as well:[/h3]

notes.title: New Free Level Coming This Sunday
notes.content:
Jingle Jam 2024 is about to start this Sunday, and Nina was kind enough to draw a brand-new level for this year's edition. This time, the crew is on a ski trip in a winter wonderland. The cats have been practising their hiding skills all year, so finding them all will be much more difficult. 

Please mark your calendars for Sunday [b]1st December[/b], when the[b] new free level[/b] will drop. And while you're already here,[b] please vote to nominate the game for a Steam Award[/b]. It would be insane if we could get nominated and, through that, spread even more awareness for the Jingle Jam charity event. 

Peace & Love 
Patrick
